name: 922 Runtime Genie
description: Scans 7000 folders in a 922 batch for CNC machine time, matches against LST files, and outputs a run time estimate with 40% buffer
author: Anthony Sieben

setup: Sync the '922 QTDR Production Packages' folder and know which 'Batch NNN' folder you're running.
The batch's LST reference files go in the 'Batch {N} - Documentation' LST folder, and the CNC machine-time PDFs live in the orders' 7000 folders.
how_it_works: Pick the batch's own 'Batch NNN' folder when the picker opens - no batch number typing. The app scans the 7000 folders for CNC machine-time PDFs and matches them to the LST reference files.
It sums the machine times and adds a 40% buffer.
output: A 'Run Time Estimate - Batch {N}.txt' in the LST folder with the part count, total time, and the buffered final hours.

fields.label: 922 Production Packages Root
fields.description: Where 'Batch {N}' folders live. Leave blank to auto-detect '922 QTDR Production Packages' under your OneDrive Pilot Program folder.
fields.placeholder: Auto-detect: OneDrive \ ... \ Pilot Program \ 922 QTDR Production Packages

fields.label: Sentry Drone mode
fields.description: Pick the file or folder through the targeting-drone kill-cam - crosshair cursor, lock-on, and a railgun strike on the target. Off = a normal Explorer dialog. Buy the Sentry Drone at Woogy's Emporium; set every app at once from My Stuff.
